description: Azad Engineering Limited manufactures and sells precision-engineered components for energy and power generation, aerospace and defence, and oil and gas industries in India and internationally. It offers fixed air foil, last stage air foil rotary, welding chamfers, last stage air foil stationary, stator and rotor air foils, compressor air foils, hot gas parts, slips, drill bits, hatch cover, bonnet, and frame. The company also provides unison rings, arm, levers, assembly, body, housing, compressor and mount, valve body, butterfly plate, seal, shaft and bearing rod, piston plate and sealing ring, actuator, cover and housing, guide, poppet, tees and elbows, nipples and adaptors, aft and fore end skirt, bb2kp base, and b1 ignitor body 1 and 2. In addition, it offers aircraft engines and APUs, missiles, actuator system air generation, engine propulsion, fuel and inserting, rotating and stationary aerofoils, combustion parts, diaphragms, casings, critical machining parts, assemblies, drilling services, subsea pressure system, wireline, artificial lifting system, aerofoils, combustion parts, and castings. The company also exports its products to the United States, the United Kingdom, China, Japan, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Germany, Europe, and the Middle East. Azad Engineering Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
